name: gpt-image-2.5-flare
description: GPT Image 2.5 Flare is an image generation and editing model from OpenAI, positioned as the speed-oriented tier of the GPT Image 2.5 series. It is suited to high-volume everyday generation, creator content, and rapid prototyping via the dedicated Images API.
zhDescription: GPT Image 2.5 Flare 是 OpenAI 推出的图像生成与编辑模型，定位为 GPT Image 2.5 系列中主打生成速度的版本。适用于批量日常图像生成、内容创作和快速原型设计，可通过专用的 Images API 调用。
longDescription: GPT Image 2.5 Flare is an image generation and editing model from OpenAI, positioned as the speed-oriented tier of the GPT Image 2.5 series. It is suited to high-volume everyday generation, creator content, and rapid prototyping via the dedicated Images API.
zhLongDescription: GPT Image 2.5 Flare 是 OpenAI 推出的图像生成与编辑模型，定位为 GPT Image 2.5 系列中主打生成速度的版本。适用于批量日常图像生成、内容创作和快速原型设计，可通过专用的 Images API 调用。

usageGuide.authIntro: 使用 API Key 进行认证，在请求头中添加 Authorization Bearer：
usageGuide.requestIntro: 使用 OpenAI Responses API 参数格式：
usageGuide.requestExample:
{
  "instructions": "你是一个有帮助的助手",
  "input": "你好，请介绍一下自己",
  "temperature": 0.5,
  "model": "gpt-image-2.5-flare",
  "max_output_tokens": 4096
}
usageGuide.docLabel: 查看完整 API 文档

python.code:
import requests

url = "http://10.191.0.202/v1/responses"
headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <api_key>",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
data = {
    "model": "gpt-image-2.5-flare",
    "instructions": "You are a helpful assistant.",
    "input": "What is the meaning of life?",
    "max_output_tokens": 1024
}
response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data)
print(response.json()["output_text"])

javascript.installLine: 无需安装额外依赖（需 Node 18+ 或支持 fetch 的运行环境）

curl.installLine: 说明：macOS / Linux 一般已预装 curl
curl.code:
curl -X POST "http://10.191.0.202/v1/responses" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-image-2.5-flare","instructions":"You are a helpful assistant.","input":"What is the meaning of life?","max_output_tokens":1024}'
